authors.description: the authors as the page writes them, without the year (for example `Vaswani et al.`)

url.description: where to read the paper; an arXiv abstract page when there is one, otherwise the publisher, a PDF or a book page

arxiv_id.description: present only when `url` is an arXiv link, taken from it by code

topics.description: FKs → research-topic/<slug>: every topic the paper is listed under; empty when it belongs to none

must_read.description: present only for the papers on the must-read list

era.description: the era heading the paper sits under, newest era first

order.description: position in the must-read list, 1 = first

is_high_impact.description: one of the few papers the page highlights beside the lists

summary.description: the short must-read text, kept when a longer text fills the `Why It Matters` section
